translations.web: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together and encamped in Gilead. The children of Israel assembled themselves together and encamped in Mizpah.
translations.bsb: Then the Ammonites were called to arms and camped in Gilead, and the Israelites assembled and camped at Mizpah.
